# Smart Infrastructure Lead Intelligence v0.1.0

## Highlights

- Static and Playwright web scraping.
- Controlled crawling with retries and pacing.
- Rule-based business signal detection.
- Transparent lead scoring.
- Single and batch CLI workflows.
- Excel reporting and dashboard summaries.
- Docker packaging and CI automation.
- Automated test suite verified at `325 passed, 1 skipped`.

## Responsible use

This release is intended for legitimate public-data B2B/B2G research and
portfolio demonstration. It does not bypass authentication, CAPTCHA, or
anti-bot controls.

## Notes

The included example organisations and contact details are fictional.
